notes: Run of 2026-11-14. Six Mission Local stories read; none earns an entry. The Mission Branch Library preview is a second account of a reopening the page already carries; the Tenderloin column's headline is a roundup; the SRO elevator and holiday-market stories name addresses only in passing. The cactus and Visitacion Valley stories name no address.

findings.description: Preview of the renovated Mission Branch Library ahead of its Saturday reopening.

citation.label: Mission Local, “The Mission District’s library will reopen this weekend. Here’s a peek inside.,” 13 November 2026

raw.text: the newly renovated Mission Branch Library at 3359 24th St.

publish.note: One event, one entry: the reopening is already carried on /san-francisco/mission/bartlett-street/300/ by Mission Local's 2026-10-09 entry, and Hoodline's 10 Nov account was declined on the same ground. The reopening itself (14 Nov) is a distinct event a later story may carry. building.architect already filled; nothing to add.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 3359 24TH ST → parcel 6515001; sf-parcels has blklot 6515001 active, 3359–3359 24TH; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1900. The assessor files the parcel as 300 BARTLETT ST.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 499 ELLIS ST → parcel 0333015; sf-parcels has blklot 0333015 active, 479–499 ELLIS; the 2025 roll records it as commercial retail, built 1922.
